findings.title: Mandatory owner regression fails before its T6 head-day denial oracle
findings.description: The exact mandatory transaction_owner_regressions_pass command exits 1 at tested_commit 3e1fdaf491929ad5963ec4491cb1d1139fc1b8e8: 1 failed, 57 passed. test_reauthorize_requires_atomic_intent_success changes RUNNING INTENT to 2026-09-27, where its fixture already contains RUNNING INTENT_2 with the same subject and PLAN purpose. The required uq_s27_active_partition index rejects the fixture update before the intended Reauthorize head-day mismatch oracle and remaining atomic-success assertions execute. The committed BLOCKED/FAIL/UNMERGED result is accurate, but the packet DoD and Merge Gate require every exact check to pass. The proposed patch is unapplied and cannot close this finding.

KL-024 explicitly excludes tests/db/test_transaction_interfaces.py. Preserve the frozen uniqueness index and all required cases; do not waive, skip or deselect the regression. After the authorized repair, rerun every exact required check on the resulting stable implementation revision, commit new evidence/result, and obtain fresh SHA-bound required reviews.

prior_finding_disposition.basis: Completion now requires both the exact number of S30 effects and equality with the prepared distinct quota ID set. Per-effect guards bind subject, row and count+1. With two distinct prepared quotas this requires exactly one effect per bucket. The migrated negative test instruments both calls to target the first bucket and asserts GuardRequired plus complete rollback; it is included in the committed 6-pass planning DB suite. GENERAL inspected the repair and assertions; DB_CONCURRENCY independently owns database execution.

All three typed planning commands now add replayed=true on preflight receipt replay, under-S01 historical replay, and idempotent_outcome replay. Tests distinguish replay metadata from original durable identities, cover acquire after takeover, admission/acquire/renew after revision and cancellation, force preflight misses for the under-S01 paths, and assert unchanged persisted state/counts. No replay reacquires worker authority.

Versioned normalization separates partition from semantic fingerprint and calendar scope, handles NFC/trim and equipment set semantics, preserves ordered lists, rejects type/key collisions and bounds depth/size. Admission resolves immutable active S05 policy under S01; root policy, hour/day quotas, purpose/calendar/trigger admission and same-day concurrency are applied. Root limits/reserved/settled categories and ADMITTED meaning are explicit. Terminal roots require explicit fresh admission; terminal attempts are not revived.

JOIN returns the existing chain without request/attempt creation, quota debit or S27 mutation. REVISE appends one immutable S28 and CREATED S29, invalidates exactly the prior attempt and atomically switches pointers while preserving root budget, deadline, lease and fence. Deep-copying the prepared basis protects owner guards. Tests inspect current pointers, nonzero counters, stale request/attempt denial through existing shared and T6 guards, basis changes, return to earlier constraints, payload conflicts and injected transaction rollback.

Acquire/renew reuse the sole owner, trusted post-lock time and current chain guards. Acquisition uses exact owner/fence CAS and a strictly greater token with future deadline-bounded expiry; renewal requires live current owner/token/request/attempt and strict extension, rereads post-lock state, and rechecks lease at mutation. Both remain S27-only for mutations/aggregate locks. Shared fence guards reject terminal attempts while preserving documented merged nonterminal compatibility. Interleaving tests use bounded barriers/events and PostgreSQL blocking observations. No model/network work occurs inside coordination.

The additive migration follows d4c1a9e7b203 and implements frozen subject/date/purpose active uniqueness with documented legacy PENDING compatibility. Scope comparison confirms only declared implementation paths and task-scoped result/evidence/reviews; historical migrations, frozen Protocol/DB/FROZEN_BASELINE, current index/requirement registry and excluded owner fixture are unchanged. No shared package marker, authorization implementation, live shadow head, dispatch/model/reaper work, production activation or product requirement PASS is added.

GENERAL finds one BLOCKER and no additional REQUIRED_FOLLOWUP or NONBLOCKING issues. No merge recommendation is issued. The frozen index should remain intact; repair is a bounded fixture/scope governance matter, not SPEC_CHANGE_REQUIRED. DB_CONCURRENCY and PROTOCOL reviews must bind this exact revision, and substantive future repairs require new checks/result/reviews. Only this GENERAL review artifact was written; no commit, code/result/evidence mutation, DB run or Docker lifecycle was performed.
